title: fix(gemini): keep thought summaries out of the output and count thinking tokens

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,3 @@
+### PR [#2284](https://github.com/danielmiessler/Fabric/pull/2284) by [pcbeingused333](https://github.com/pcbeingused333) and [ksylvan](https://github.com/ksylvan): fix(gemini): keep thought summaries out of the output and count thinking tokens
+
+- Leave Gemini and Vertex AI thought summaries out of the response text and report thinking tokens as output tokens.

@@ -0,0 +1,33 @@
+package geminicommon
+
+import (
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
+	"google.golang.org/genai"
+)
+
+func TestExtractTextSkipsThoughtParts(t *testing.T) {
+	response := &genai.GenerateContentResponse{
+		Candidates: []*genai.Candidate{{
+			Content: &genai.Content{Parts: []*genai.Part{
+				{Text: "**Planning the answer**", Thought: true},
+				{Text: "The answer is 2."},
+			}},
+		}},
+	}
+
+	assert.Equal(t, "The answer is 2.", ExtractText(response))
+	assert.Equal(t, "The answer is 2.", ExtractTextWithCitations(response))
+}
+
+func TestOutputTokenCountIncludesThoughts(t *testing.T) {
+	usage := &genai.GenerateContentResponseUsageMetadata{
+		PromptTokenCount:     10,
+		CandidatesTokenCount: 20,
+		ThoughtsTokenCount:   70,
+		TotalTokenCount:      100,
+	}
+
+	assert.Equal(t, 90, OutputTokenCount(usage))
+}
